items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Why didn't he bring Joe Gordon out to a parade?

ctx.x: That's with Brian? Yeah, with Brian.

The young trumpet player? Yeah. That's right. So I said, never no more. I had a job sitting out. Why didn't he bring Joe Gordon out to a parade? I'd rather stay in New Orleans and play a car with the parade, and go out there and play. Because you do get some kind of a parade to rest. Something to eat, something to drink. Out there, you're gonna get nothing. That's a lot of things.
Do you know that club they call the Buzzards?
